subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: While the switch-over is in effect, the system shall refuse every new PRD ledger entry, technical design document, brainstorm record, and review report in Pyxis's own repository.
rationale: The document pipeline closes for new contract work (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-6, brainstorm:feature-draft#D-17; Q3 answered by design-brainstorm:feature-draft-tech-design#D-15)
fit_criterion: On the released tree, fixtures adding a new PRD base, a PRD amendment, a technical design document, a brainstorm record, or a review report are each refused with a remedy naming the feature draft, while a new plan document is accepted.
